note: Product page accordions, stored in Shopify as product metafields custom.fabric_fit, custom.features and custom.care. Illustrative copy for a fictional brand. Scarp Shell's text is from the design.

tarn-merino-crew.fabric_fit: 150 gsm merino wool jersey around a fine nylon core for durability. Slim fit that sits flat under a mid layer, with a longer back hem.
tarn-merino-crew.features: Flatlock seams that don't rub under pack straps. Raglan sleeves for free arm movement. Crew neck with soft tape at the back.
tarn-merino-crew.care: Machine wash cold on a wool cycle and dry flat. No tumble dryer and no fabric softener.

tarn-merino-quarter-zip.fabric_fit: 200 gsm merino wool jersey, warmer than the crew for cold starts. Slim fit with longer sleeves and a dropped back hem.
tarn-merino-quarter-zip.features: Quarter-length front zip with a zip garage at the chin, to dump heat on the climb. Thumb loops keep the cuffs in place under gloves. Flatlock seams.
tarn-merino-quarter-zip.care: Machine wash cold on a wool cycle and dry flat. No tumble dryer and no fabric softener.

knoll-quarter-zip.fabric_fit: Smooth-faced fleece with a soft brushed inside. Regular fit that layers over a base and under any shell.
knoll-quarter-zip.features: Quarter zip with a high collar. One zipped chest pocket. Stretch binding at the cuffs and hem.
knoll-quarter-zip.care: Machine wash warm, inside out, and tumble dry low.

knoll-grid-fleece.fabric_fit: Grid-back fleece: raised squares trap warm air and the channels between them let moisture out. Athletic fit for hard-working days.
knoll-grid-fleece.features: Full-length front zip. Two zipped hand pockets set high to clear a hip belt. Stretch side panels.
knoll-grid-fleece.care: Close the zips, machine wash warm and tumble dry low.

bothy-pile-jacket.fabric_fit: High-loft pile fleece that stays warm when damp and dries quickly. Relaxed fit with room to wear it over a base and a light fleece.
bothy-pile-jacket.features: Full-length zip with a stand-up collar. Two zipped hand pockets and an inside drop pocket for gloves. Woven trim at the cuffs and hem.
bothy-pile-jacket.care: Machine wash cold and tumble dry low. Brush the pile gently if it flattens.

belay-hoody.fabric_fit: Synthetic fill quilted into a ripstop nylon face that sheds snow and drizzle. Cut long, with room to wear it over a harness and a fleece.
belay-hoody.features: Helmet-compatible hood with a one-pull adjuster. Two-way front zip for belay access. Two hand pockets and an inside mesh pocket. Packs into its own pocket.
belay-hoody.care: Machine wash cold with a technical wash. Tumble dry low with two clean tennis balls to bring back the loft.

cornice-down-jacket.fabric_fit: Down fill in baffled chambers under a wind-resistant nylon face. Boxy, relaxed fit made to go over everything at camp.
cornice-down-jacket.features: Insulated hood and a high collar with a soft chin guard. Two fleece-lined hand pockets and two inside drop pockets. Elastic cuffs and an adjustable hem.
cornice-down-jacket.care: Wash with a down cleaner on a gentle cycle, then tumble dry low with dryer balls until the down is fully dry.

squall-jacket.fabric_fit: Lightweight two-layer waterproof nylon with a mesh liner. Trim fit for running and fast hiking.
squall-jacket.features: Packs into its own chest pocket. Hood with an elastic face opening. Reflective details front and back. Elastic cuffs and a drawcord hem.
squall-jacket.care: Machine wash cold and line dry. Tumble dry low now and then to refresh the water-repellent finish.

ridgeback-softshell.fabric_fit: Double-weave stretch softshell that blocks wind and sheds light rain while it breathes. Athletic fit that moves with you on scrambles.
ridgeback-softshell.features: Low-profile hood that fits under a helmet. Two hand pockets set high to clear a harness. Adjustable cuffs and a drawcord hem.
ridgeback-softshell.care: Machine wash cold and tumble dry low to refresh the water-repellent finish. No fabric softener.

downpour-jacket.fabric_fit: 2.5-layer waterproof, breathable fabric with fully taped seams. Regular fit with room for a fleece underneath.
downpour-jacket.features: Stowable hood that rolls into the collar. Two zipped hand pockets. Storm flap over the front zip. Adjustable cuffs and hem.
downpour-jacket.care: Machine wash warm with a technical wash and tumble dry low to refresh the water-repellent finish.

scarp-shell.fabric_fit: Three-layer waterproof fabric with a brushed backer, so it does not feel clammy against a base layer. Relaxed fit through the body to leave room for a mid and an insulation layer.
scarp-shell.features: Helmet-compatible hood with a laminated brim. Two chest pockets that clear a hip belt. 12-inch pit zips. Adjustable cuffs and hem.
scarp-shell.care: Machine wash warm with a technical wash, tumble dry low to refresh the water-repellent finish. No fabric softener.
